title.en: A  Amending Section 4 of Presidential Decree No. 576 Entitled "Abolishing the Media Advisory Council and the Bureau of Standards for Mass Media, and Authorizing the Organization of Regulatory Councils for Print Media and for Broadcast Media

text.en:
Section 4 of Presidential Decree No. 576 is hereby amended to read as follows:
"Sec. 4. No mass media activity shall be undertaken by any person or entity in the Philippines without first
being registered with the regulatory council or body concerned, which shall issue certificates of registration to
all applicants qualified under its respective rules or regulations: Provided, That each council shall have the
authority to suspend or cancel such certificates of registration for such cause as may be provided in the rules
and the existence of which each council or body shall have duly determined: Provided, further, That no
certificate of registration shall be granted in any manner or under any condition to any of those engaged in
mass media which were, in September 1972, ordered closed and/or sequestered upon promulgation of
Proclamation No. 1081, by order of the President or the Minister of National Defense, OR WHICH
THEREAFTER MAY BE ORDERED CLOSED AS A CONSEQUENCE THAT IT HAS BEEN UTILIZED
FOR PURPOSES OF SUBVERSION, SEDITION AND OTHER SUBVERSIVE ACTIVITIES INIMICAL
TO THE NATIONAL SECURITY."

This Decree shall take effect immediately.
Done in the City of Manila, this 12th day of September in the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and eighty.
